name: Carousel
description: Paged carousel with a sliding or fading transition, drag, autoplay and a controller that drives the dot row.

fields.transition: CarouselTransition? - sliding or fading; null = sliding
fields.alignment: CarouselAlignment? - where the page sits; null = center
fields.viewportFraction: double? - viewport share per page; null = 1
fields.itemExtent: double? - fixed page extent; wins over viewportFraction
fields.autoplayInterval: Duration? - hold time per page; null disables autoplay

notes: `CarouselTransition.sliding({gap})` / `.fading()` (an abstract class with a `const factory` per variant) become the `CarouselTransition` enum plus an exhaustive switch; `CarouselSizeConstraint` and its two one-field subclasses become `itemExtent` / `viewportFraction`.
`CarouselIndicator` (the old `CarouselDotIndicator`, a 20-line pass-through) is deleted: compose `DotIndicator` with the controller, as the preview shows.
`wrap`, `draggable` and `pauseOnHover` are theme rows only; they have no widget argument (a behavioural knob is not structure).
`CarouselController` lives in `carousel_style.dart` next to the theme rows and the pure layout math, so both files stay under the 400-line limit.
The batch data lists `dot_indicator` as a component dependency; it is not imported, so `deps.components` is empty (an unimported dep would raise an `unused-dependency` finding).
